scene_brief: Evening living room. Neet foreground left in a real low crouched play-bow-like stance, fine forelegs extended and rear planted, fixated on ONE tiny mosquito hovering in lamplight ahead; small actual insect, not monster. Buddy right is hidden comfortably beneath a soft blanket beside couch, just furnished head and a forepaw visible at the open corner, looking toward Neet; blanket mound plausibly covers continuous elongated body, no detached head. Leave another open fold as invitation for Neet to join. Cropped human lower arm at far upper edge holds an electric mosquito racket upright away from dogs, no face. Couch, lamp and tile floor enough context. Comedy heroic preparation versus sensible refuge; no repellent hitting dog, no sparks or injury.
